data.one_liner: All-in-one framework for reactive state management, context-less routing, and dependency injection.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive Flutter framework uniting reactive and simple state management, dependency lookup, and route management without requiring BuildContext. It also includes built-in utilities for internationalization, theme toggling, and network requests via GetConnect. Developers can observe state changes using .obs extensions and Obx widgets without code generation or boilerplate.
use_when: You want a unified framework for state management, navigation, and dependency injection without BuildContext dependency
You need rapid prototyping with minimal boilerplate and simple reactive state hooks (.obs)
You want automatic memory management and disposal of controllers as routes change
avoid_when: You prefer idiomatic Flutter architecture adhering strictly to Flutter's standard widget tree and BuildContext lifecycle
You want modular, decoupled libraries focused exclusively on single responsibilities rather than a monolithic framework
strengths: Combines state management, navigation, and dependency injection in a single package
Zero boilerplate reactive programming without code generation or StreamControllers
Removes controllers from memory automatically when unused by default
weaknesses: Monolithic approach tightly couples core app architecture (routing, DI, state) to a single third-party package
Bypassing Flutter's native BuildContext and Navigator can cause compatibility friction across major Flutter SDK updates
data.setup_notes: Wrapping your root app in GetMaterialApp is required for context-less navigation, snackbars, and dialogs.
